title: Lion cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <!-- front leg lifted -->
  <rect x='60' y='60' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#F2B33D' transform='rotate(30 63 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FFE29A' transform='rotate(30 68 56)'/>
  <!-- other front leg down -->
  <rect x='57' y='72' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='87' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M32 66 Q20 62 18 50' stroke='#D98E24' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='48' r='5' fill='#8B4A0F'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#C4661A' stroke-width='5' stroke-dasharray='6 5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='20' r='5' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#FFB3B3'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='20' r='5' fill='#D98E24'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#FFB3B3'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='3' fill='#3B2A12'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='3' fill='#3B2A12'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 38 L53 38 L50 42 Z' fill='#C4661A'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 42 Q46 46 43 44 M50 42 Q54 46 57 44' stroke='#C4661A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M40 40 L32 39 M40 43 L32 44 M60 40 L68 39 M60 43 L68 44' stroke='#E0A83A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='28' r='3' fill='#5FD0FF'/>
  <rect x='24' y='14' width='2' height='14' fill='#5FD0FF'/>
  <path d='M26 14 Q32 16 30 22' stroke='#5FD0FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='36' r='3' fill='#FF7AC2'/>
  <rect x='78' y='22' width='2' height='14' fill='#FF7AC2'/>
  <path d='M80 22 Q86 24 84 30' stroke='#FF7AC2' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
